description.value: El Paisano is a family-owned Latin American grocery store with two downtown Vancouver locations — one on Davie Street and one inside Granville SkyTrain Station — specializing in authentic ingredients, spices, snacks, and beverages from Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and Venezuela. Founded by food lovers with roots in Mexico, the shop brings hard-to-find Latin pantry staples to the heart of the city. The Davie Street location is walkable from the Seawall cycling route and the West End.
